methodologyNotes: Prices fetched directly from each vendor's official /pricing page via WebFetch on 2026-06-14. Fivetran uses consumption-based MAR (Monthly Active Rows) pricing with no fixed monthly floor on Standard/Enterprise/Business Critical tiers — those plans have monthlyUsd=null as the cost varies entirely by data volume. Stitch Advanced and Premium are billed annually only; monthlyUsd reflects the annualized monthly rate. Airbyte Cloud has two product lines (Agents and Data Replication); both are represented. Hevo Starter price listed is the monthly (non-annual) rate; annual rate is 20% lower. Matillion publishes no USD figures — all plans are consumption-credit-based with custom quotes. Rivery Base plan is pay-as-you-go at $0.90/BDU credit with no stated monthly minimum, so monthlyUsd=null. Where a vendor's official page returned 403/404, the corroboration source is a third-party aggregator that retrieved pricing from the vendor's public page. HIPAA/BAA noted only when explicitly stated by the vendor.

vendors.name: Fivetran
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.fivetran.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. Fivetran uses a consumption-based MAR (Monthly Active Rows) model. Free plan includes 500K MAR/month at $0. Standard, Enterprise, and Business Critical plans bill per MAR consumed — no fixed monthly floor is published on the pricing page, so those plans carry monthlyUsd=null. Up to 22% annual discount available on Standard. PCI DSS Level 1 noted for Business Critical; HIPAA not explicitly mentioned on the pricing page.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 500K MAR/month, 3.5K MAR activations, 5K model runs/month. Access to core platform functionality. 700+ connectors available.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Consumption-based per MAR. Includes 700+ connectors, unlimited users, 15-minute syncs, dbt Core integration, RBAC, SSH tunnels. $5 base charge per connection applies. Cost scales with monthly active rows synced. Up to 22% annual discount available.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Consumption-based per MAR. Adds 1-minute syncs, Audience Hub, custom roles, VPN tunnels, cloud provider choice. Annual contract required for VPN access.

plans.name: Business Critical
plans.notes: Consumption-based per MAR. Adds customer-managed encryption keys, PCI DSS Level 1, private networking. All Enterprise features included.

vendors.name: Airbyte
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://airbyte.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. Airbyte has two product lines: Airbyte Agents (AI/MCP-oriented) and Data Replication (traditional ETL). Airbyte Core is open-source/self-hosted (always free). HIPAA/BAA not mentioned on pricing page. 600+ replication connectors advertised.

plans.name: Core (Open Source)
plans.notes: Self-managed open-source deployment. Always free. Full control over infrastructure.

plans.name: Agents Free
plans.notes: Airbyte Agents product line. 1,000 AOs/month. Single user. API and MCP access. Daily Context Store refreshes. Community and AI support.

plans.name: Agents Individual
plans.notes: Airbyte Agents product line. 5,000 AOs/month included; overage at $0.004/AO. Single user. Hourly Context Store refresh. Standard and AI support.

plans.name: Agents Team
plans.notes: Airbyte Agents product line. 10,000 AOs/month included; overage at $0.005/AO. Multiple users/workspaces. Parallel execution. Standard and AI support.

plans.name: Data Replication Standard
plans.notes: Traditional ETL/ELT product line. Starting at $10/month; volume-based pricing scales with data synced. Fully managed cloud hosting. 600+ connectors. Quick deployment.

plans.name: Data Replication Plus
plans.notes: Annual plan billed at $500/month equivalent. 50 credits included. 15-minute syncs. Custom mappings. Aimed at teams needing predictable annual billing.

plans.name: Data Replication Pro
plans.notes: Multiple workspaces, SSO, RBAC, premium support. Capacity-based (Data Workers). Contact sales for pricing.

vendors.name: Stitch
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.stitchdata.com/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14. Standard plan available monthly or annually; Advanced and Premium billed annually only. HIPAA and BAA signing explicitly listed as a feature on Advanced and Premium plans. US pricing only per the page note.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Starts at $100/month for 5M rows/month. Scales up to 300M rows/month. 1 destination, 10 standard sources, 5 users, 7-day historical sync. Available monthly or annually. Rows-based usage pricing.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Billed annually only ($18,000/year). 100M rows/month. 3 destinations, unlimited enterprise sources, unlimited users, 60-day extraction log retention. HIPAA compliance with BAA signing included.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Billed annually only ($36,000/year). 1B rows/month. 5 destinations, unlimited enterprise sources, unlimited users. HIPAA compliance with BAA signing included.

vendors.name: Hevo Data
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://hevodata.com/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14. Free plan is 0$/month up to 1M events. Starter monthly price is $299/month (month-to-month); annual rate is $239/month (20% discount). Professional monthly price is $849/month (month-to-month); annual rate is $679/month. Business Critical is custom/contact sales. HIPAA not explicitly mentioned on the pricing page (GetApp aggregator lists HIPAA for Business tier, but official page does not confirm on pricing page — set to null).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 1M events/month. 1-hour sync scheduling. Up to 5 users. 50+ free connectors.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Month-to-month price $299/month; annual price $239/month (20% discount). Starts at 5M events/month; tiers for 20M and 50M available. Up to 10 users. 150+ connectors. dbt integration. SSH/SSL. 24x7 live chat support.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Month-to-month price $849/month; annual price $679/month (20% discount). 20M, 50M, or 100M events/month tiers available. Unlimited users. Hevo APIs. Reverse SSH. Add-ons available.

plans.name: Business Critical
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Includes streaming pipelines, RBAC, SSO, multiple workspaces, VPC peering, advanced security. Contact sales.

vendors.name: Matillion
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.matillion.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. No USD prices are published. All three plans (Developer, Teams, Scale) use a consumption-credit model with annual subscriptions but display no dollar figures. Pricing requires contacting sales or starting a trial. monthlyUsd=null on all plans.

plans.name: Developer
plans.notes: 1 developer user, unlimited admin users. Consumption-based credit model. Unlimited projects, pre-built connectors, low-code canvas, SQL/Python support, built-in Git. Free trial available. No public USD price.

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: 5 developer users, unlimited admin users. Annual subscription with included credits. Audit log, standard customer support, SLA. Most Popular designation. No public USD price.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: 5 developer users, unlimited admin users. Annual subscription. Custom SSO, hybrid cloud deployment, data lineage, streaming CDC, 180+ day log retention, bring-your-own Git, Premium Support. No public USD price.

plans.name: Advanced

plans.name: Enterprise

vendors.name: Integrate.io
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.integrate.io/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14. Core plan at $1,999/month is publicly listed. plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Fixed monthly flat fee. Unlimited connectors, unlimited data volumes, unlimited pipelines. 30-day onboarding included. No row-based or usage overage charges. Free trial available.

plans.name: Enterprise

vendors.name: Rivery
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://rivery.io/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14. SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliance listed on the pricing page as available starting at the Professional tier (not the Base tier). 14-day free trial includes 1,000 credits (worth ~$1,200 at list rate).

plans.name: Enterprise
